title: The Deep Asset
premise: Coral Ravensworth, a disgraced intelligence analyst with a go-bag by the door, is approached by a stranger who claims she once saved his life — a favor she has no memory of performing. The debt he repays drags her into a conspiracy: a buried financial instrument, 'the Deep Asset,' that three governments will kill to keep hidden before Frankfurt markets open. As Coral's fractured memories prove to be the key, she assembles an unlikely found family of burned operatives who choose her over their handlers. In the end, Coral gets the truth out at dawn, confronts the assassin who is revealed to be tied to her erased past, and finally stops running — choosing belonging over escape.
about_author: Lena Kavanagh is a former financial journalist who spent a decade covering intelligence leaks and market manipulation from London and Berlin. She writes thrillers about people whose loyalties are tested by institutions that treat memory as a liability.

chapters.title: The Favor That Never Happened
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. Burnt out in a Lisbon safehouse flat, Coral keeps her go-bag packed and rehearses her cover story. A stranger named Ilya Voss appears claiming she saved his life in Vienna — a night she cannot remember. He leaves a key and a warning: interest is owed. Emotional beat: unease; the first crack in her polished lie.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. Following the key to a Zurich deposit box, Coral finds evidence she did work in Vienna — files bearing her own handwriting on the Deep Asset, a shadow instrument moving money through three governments' black budgets. Someone is watching the box. Emotional beat: vertigo; her missing memory becomes a threat, not a comfort.

chapters.title: Three Flags
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Coral and Marcus Hale, a weary MI6 liaison. Coral realizes British, American, and German services all want her silent before Frankfurt opens. Hale offers protection with strings attached; she declines and runs. Emotional beat: betrayal — every institution she served now hunts her.

chapters.title: The Go-Bag Rule
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. On the run through Marseille, Coral meets Nadia Okafor, a forger who patches her documents without payment, citing debts of her own. For the first time someone helps her expecting nothing. Emotional beat: warmth breaking through paranoia; the seed of found family.

chapters.title: The Man Who Collects
chapters.summary: POV: assassin Tomas Reiner. Reiner, methodical and quietly haunted, closes in on Coral, killing a contact to send a message. We learn he carries a photo of Vienna too — and hesitates when he sees Coral's face. Emotional beat: dread laced with mystery; the hunter knows her.

chapters.title: Vienna, Remembered
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. With Nadia and Ilya, Coral reconstructs the erased night: she discovered the Deep Asset, refused to bury it, and was memory-wiped by her own agency. Her 'burnout' was engineered. Emotional beat: grief and fury — her exile was a sentence, not a failure.

chapters.title: Chosen Company
chapters.summary: POV: alternating Coral and Hale. The ragged crew — Ilya, Nadia, and defector tech Anselm — plan to broadcast the Deep Asset ledger before Frankfurt opens. Hale defects from MI6, bringing encryption keys, choosing Coral over the institution. Emotional beat: belonging; she stops being alone.

chapters.title: Frankfurt Eve
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. The team infiltrates a data hub beneath Frankfurt's financial district while governments negotiate Coral's quiet disappearance. A mole among them tips off Reiner. Emotional beat: rising dread; trust itself becomes the vulnerability.

chapters.title: Before the Bell
chapters.summary: POV: Coral and Reiner. Climax: Reiner corners Coral on the trading floor as markets near open. He reveals he was the operative ordered to erase her in Vienna — and couldn't finish it. She convinces him to stand down; they push the ledger live seconds before the bell. Emotional beat: catharsis; truth outruns the bullet.

chapters.title: What Stays
chapters.summary: POV: Coral. Markets reel, inquiries open, and the crew scatters — but not apart. Coral unpacks her go-bag for the first time in years and keeps a standing dinner date with her chosen family. Reiner sends a postcard: no address, just thanks. Emotional beat: resolution; she finally belongs somewhere.
